spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). A busy conveyor-belt sushi bar in Sanchong at lunchtime. Every stool along the counter is taken, so the woman sits on the man's lap at the counter, blushing and embarrassed, while he laughs; colorful plates of sushi glide past on the belt in front of them. Other diners are simple background clay figures, out of focus. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
